editorial.description_en: Haze thick enough to have a colour of its own — the quiet member of the deep blues, and the one that behaves as a neutral beside them.
editorial.description_ja: 濃い靄のような、しずかな青灰色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.556, C 0.046, h 262.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 深 (fuka, deep) + 靄 (moya, haze). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Deep Haze" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 深靄. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — ame-iwa at ΔE00 8.2, yu-dachi at ΔE00 8.5, yoru-kawa at ΔE00 8.9. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (82°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
